Water Quality
Page 26 of the draft statement states that the dikes are in need of improvement. Yet, it is unclear what improvements will be required in the dike system, and whether the improvements to the dike system are included in this statement.
2. Additionally, what is the frequency of occurrence, and what is the likelihood that the combination of high tides and stormwater run-off will result in flooding of the Alviso area?
3. Page 88 of the draft statement indicates the expansion of "minor and temporary siltation". In what areas can the incidents of siltation be expected to occur, and for what duration of time can siltation be expected to present a problem?
4. What measures are planned to mitigate the impacts of siltation on water quality?
